messages:
Leah: Noticing weird p99 jumps on /v1/embeddings this morning after the small model swap. p50 steady, p95 small tick, p99 doubled. Anyone else?
Devon: Yep, saw it in US-WEST. Appears scoped to route=embeddings.bulk_upload and only during batching windows.
Ravi: Could be that one variant is getting batched differently or has cold kv loads. Do we have per-variant percentiles?
Leah: Console only shows percentiles by route. Rollout panel has variant weights but not tied into the latency cards.
metrics-bot: alert: series p99(/v1/embeddings) exceeded baseline by 2x at 07:12:34 UTC.
Devon: Quick check: p99 jump coincides with fallback weight increase from 0.02 -> 0.20 in the rollout window.
Ravi: That would do it. If fallback has poor kv_cache_hit_rate or sits on smaller instances, tail moves while median doesn't.
Leah: Can you run a split query? I want to see sample counts and p99 per-variant over the last 10m.
Ravi: Running PromQL-ish snippet now:

```
label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le,variant) (rate(request_latency_bucket{endpoint="/v1/embeddings"}[10m]))), "variant", "$1", "variant", "(.*)")
```

Ravi: Results look like: main p99 ~120ms (12k samples), fallback p99 ~1.1s (410 samples).
Devon: There it is. Low sample fallback dominating p99; dashboard tdigest merge is hiding the variant split provenance.
Leah: This means the overall p99 is misleading because it's a blended percentile with uneven sample weights. We should show per-variant sample counts inline.
UXMaya: UX idea: tiny inline chip next to p99 like: "p99 · 12.3k samples". On hover show: "breakdown: main 97% (12k) · fallback 3% (410) — fallback p99 1.1s" with link to expand variant chart.
Devon: Operationally we should also have a rule: if a single variant contributes >30% of p99 delta and has <1000 samples, display a caution banner: "tail driven by small-sample variant".
Leah: Agreed. Also add a "provenance" toggle in the UI to switch rollup mode: show merged tdigest (default) vs per-variant enumeration.
Ravi: For immediate triage, I'll pin routing to main for 5 minutes and watch p99. I can also check kv cache hit by variant with: 

```
SELECT variant, count(*) as n, quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) FROM requests
WHERE endpoint='/v1/embeddings' AND time > now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY variant;
```

Ravi: Quick run shows fallback kv_cache_hit_rate=21%, main=88%. Token sizes similar.
Devon: Sounds like fallback infra needs warming. Leah, want me to open an infra ticket?
Leah: Yes INF-3503 to track fallback warmup and instance sizing. Include the sample sizes and query snippets.
UXMaya: Delivery note: we can implement the inline chip quickly (small visual + tooltip). Per-variant expansion may take a sprint. I'll sketch the microcopy: "p99 (12.7k samples) — variant contribution available"
metrics-bot: action: created incident draft INC-6378 for p99 spike on /v1/embeddings.
Ravi: I've temporarily reduced fallback weight to 5% and enabled automatic rollback if p99 > 600ms for >2m.
Leah: After reduction p99 dropped to ~160ms within one window. Good mitigation.
Devon: Follow-ups:
- UXMaya: implement chip + tooltip (P0 low-effort).
- Metrics team: add variant tags to percentile rollup metadata + sample counts.
- Infra: investigate fallback instance type and improve kv warmup strategy.
- Runbook: add variant-split troubleshooting steps and queries.
Leah: I'll post a short runbook blurb in #eng-oncall and link the infra ticket. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
